overview.description: The First Trust Natural Gas ETF (FCG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Nasdaq FactSet Natural Gas index. The fund seeks to track an index of US-listed companies involved in the exploration, production, and midstream activities of natural gas. FCG was launched on May 8, 2007 and is issued by First Trust.
